title_sq: Ne Astir, Shitet Njesi Biznesi Ideale Per Investim!!!
description_sq: Ne zonen e Astirit, ne nje nga rruget me te frekuentuara shitet ambient biznesi ne katin e pare buze rruges kryesore. Ambienti ka siperfaqe totale 273 m2 dhe organizohet si open space dhe nje ambient zyre i vecuar bashke me nje tualet te dedikuar. Ambienti eshte goxha i aksesueshem per shkak dhe te lokacionit perfekt ne zemer te Astirit. Ambienti ka fasade xhami nga te dyja krahet e saj cka e ben shume te mire edhe per brandim te biznesit . Hapesira mund te shfrytezohet per tipologji te ndryshme biznesi si klinika dentare ,laboratore te ndryshem, dyqane, call center etj . Zona e Astirit vitet e fundi ka pasur nje zhvillim mjaft te mire ne infrastukture dhe nisur nga numri i larte i popullsise qe banon eshte nje zone me potenciale te larta ne zhvillimin e bizneseve te ndryshme sidomos ne fushen e sherbimeve. Prona disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: In Astir, an ideal business unit for investment!!!
description_en: In the area of ​​Astir, on one of the most frequented streets, a business premises is for sale on the first floor by the main road. The environment has a total area of ​​273 m2 and is organized as an open space and a separate office environment together with a dedicated toilet. The environment is very accessible due to the perfect location in the heart of Astir. The environment has glass facades on both sides, which makes it very good for business branding. The space can be used for different types of business such as dental clinics, different laboratories, shops, call centers, etc. In recent years, the area of ​​Astir has had a very good development in infrastructure and, based on the high number of inhabitants, it is an area with high potential in the development of various businesses, especially in the field of services. The property has regular mortgage documentation.
